scope: job action consistency, daily coding title visibility, and review-schedule removal

baseline.finding: The folder-save wrapper filled the 132px action rail, but its nested trigger did not have a full-width rule, so it rendered narrower than the sibling actions.
Problem titles were constrained to one line with hidden overflow and ellipsis.
Review counts or content appeared in the workspace summary, virtual folders, learning heading and queue, settings, and notification copy.
The dashboard still counted due learning rows and scheduled maintenance still created learning-review notifications.

structuralComparison.metric: job rail controls with an explicit 100% width contract
structuralComparison.after: folder-save trigger, bookmark, and external-link controls
multi-line wrap with unrestricted card growth

desktop1440x900: The workspace summary uses one coding feature and two job summary columns.
Each coding recommendation places its badge and open action above a fully wrapped title.
The 132px job action rail gives all three primary controls the same width and a 40px minimum height.
mobile375x812: The coding feature spans the first row and two job summaries share the second row.
Coding recommendation cards become one column and retain multi-line titles.
Job actions reflow to one full-width column.

behaviorRegression: Home and learning pages do not render review-schedule summaries or due-review content.
Learning no longer requests /learning/due during page load.
Settings no longer exposes a learning-review notification preference.
D1 scheduled maintenance does not create LEARNING_REVIEW notifications, and historical rows are excluded from notification lists and unread counts.
Existing learning source, flashcard, question, and completion interactions remain available.

deploymentPackaging.initialAttempt: failed before application publish because an archive containing historical migrations tried to recreate an existing D1 table
deploymentPackaging.databaseVerification: app_schema_migrations contains 0016, 0017, and 0018 and the existing application tables remained available
deploymentPackaging.remediation: repackage the repository-provided Sites stage, which contains only the deployment-tracked 0017 and 0018 migration files

dataHandling.note: The change removes review scheduling from product surfaces and future notification generation without deleting learning content or progress records.

limitations: The responsive evidence is a deterministic source and behavior contract rather than a newly captured browser screenshot.
User-supplied screenshots were used only as the task baseline and were not copied into repository evidence because they contain personal information.
